definitions.2026_player_game_denominator: player appears in an offensive PBP participant ID field during Weeks 1-7; this is a lower bound, not a complete participation denominator.
definitions.conditional_usage: PBP play decisions grouped by pre-play score differential, quarter, remaining-time bucket, down, distance, and field zone. Player shares divide by same-team actions of the same type and context.
definitions.designed_qb_runs: QB rusher with rush_attempt, qb_scramble=0, qb_kneel=0 and qb_dropback!=1; includes detected QB sneaks.
definitions.historical_player_game_denominator: unique player-game IDs in participation offense_players; a player counts as eligible after at least one recorded offensive snap.
definitions.historical_record_boundaries: record alerts are empirical warnings, never legal or physical limits.
definitions.identity: GSIS player ID; display name is resolved from nflverse players.csv; no name-based joins.
definitions.pass_attempts: PBP pass_attempt minus sacks and all two_point_attempt rows; pass yards are attributed by passer_player_id.
definitions.position: per-game nflverse participation offense_positions mode; canonical players.csv fallback. 2026 uses weekly roster position first.
definitions.qb_sneaks: subset of designed QB runs identified by the PBP description regex in the source code; heuristic, not an NFL accounting field.
definitions.quantiles: linear interpolation over per-player-game counts; standard deviation is population SD.
definitions.receiving_yards: receiving_yards to receiver_player_id plus lateral_receiving_yards to lateral_receiver_player_id; source differences are retained in reconciliation output.
definitions.receptions: complete_pass with receiver_player_id, excluding two-point tries.
definitions.rush_attempts: PBP rush_attempt excluding two_point_attempt; includes kneels and sneaks in total carry count.
definitions.shrinkage: mean only: (player_game_n * player mean + 8 * position-window mean)/(player_game_n + 8); raw quantiles and max are never altered.
definitions.targets: pass_attempt with receiver_player_id, excluding two-point tries; missing target IDs remain in team pass-attempt denominators.
definitions.throwaways: passer attempts with an explicit "thrown away" or equivalent string in the play description; lower bound on all throwaways.
